CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS historical_imports (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	public_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	original_filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	storage_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	file_size BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	file_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	file_format VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	source_system VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	document_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	file_encoding VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	delimiter VARCHAR(1) NOT NULL, 
	period_start DATE NOT NULL, 
	period_end DATE NOT NULL, 
	parser_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	mapping_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	validation_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	mapping_json JSON, 
	metadata_json JSON, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	total_rows INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	valid_rows INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	error_rows INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	warning_rows INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pending_match_rows INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	matched_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	unmatched_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	strong_fingerprint_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	weak_fingerprint_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	dry_run_summary_json JSON, 
	confirmation_token_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	confirmation_token_expires_at DATETIME, 
	confirmation_token_used_at DATETIME, 
	created_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	previewed_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	dry_run_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	confirmed_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	reverted_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	previewed_at DATETIME, 
	dry_run_at DATETIME, 
	confirmed_at DATETIME, 
	reverted_at DATETIME, 
	revert_reason VARCHAR(1000), 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	lock_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_historical_imports_public_id UNIQUE (public_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_historical_imports_file_sha256 UNIQUE (file_sha256), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_historical_imports_storage_key UNIQUE (storage_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_historical_imports_file_format CHECK (file_format = 'csv'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_historical_imports_delimiter CHECK (delimiter = ';'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_historical_imports_period_2025 CHECK (period_start >= '2025-01-01' AND period_end <= '2025-12-31' AND period_start <= period_end), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_historical_imports_status CHECK (status IN ('uploaded', 'previewed', 'dry_run_ready', 'confirmed', 'reverted')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_historical_imports_counts_nonnegative CHECK (total_rows >= 0 AND valid_rows >= 0 AND warning_rows >= 0 AND error_rows >= 0 AND pending_match_rows >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_historical_imports_created_by_user_id FOREIGN KEY(created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_historical_imports_previewed_by_user_id FOREIGN KEY(previewed_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_historical_imports_dry_run_by_user_id FOREIGN KEY(dry_run_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_historical_imports_confirmed_by_user_id FOREIGN KEY(confirmed_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_historical_imports_reverted_by_user_id FOREIGN KEY(reverted_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_historical_imports_created_by ON historical_imports (created_by_user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_historical_imports_source_system ON historical_imports (source_system)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_hist_records_immutable_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON historical_demand_records
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM historical_imports WHERE id = OLD.import_id AND status IN ('confirmed', 'reverted')) > 0
        AND (
            NOT (OLD.id <=> NEW.id)
            OR NOT (OLD.import_id <=> NEW.import_id)
            OR NOT (OLD.source_row_number <=> NEW.source_row_number)
            OR NOT (OLD.source_record_id <=> NEW.source_record_id)
            OR NOT (OLD.source_record_id_normalized <=> NEW.source_record_id_normalized)
            OR NOT (OLD.source_line_id <=> NEW.source_line_id)
            OR NOT (OLD.source_line_id_normalized <=> NEW.source_line_id_normalized)
            OR NOT (OLD.document_type <=> NEW.document_type)
            OR NOT (OLD.document_number <=> NEW.document_number)
            OR NOT (OLD.document_number_normalized <=> NEW.document_number_normalized)
            OR NOT (OLD.event_date <=> NEW.event_date)
            OR NOT (OLD.original_product_code <=> NEW.original_product_code)
            OR NOT (OLD.normalized_product_code <=> NEW.normalized_product_code)
            OR NOT (OLD.original_product_name <=> NEW.original_product_name)
            OR NOT (OLD.normalized_product_name <=> NEW.normalized_product_name)
            OR NOT (OLD.product_id <=> NEW.product_id)
            OR NOT (OLD.suggested_product_id <=> NEW.suggested_product_id)
            OR NOT (OLD.quantity <=> NEW.quantity)
            OR NOT (OLD.unit_price <=> NEW.unit_price)
            OR NOT (OLD.record_type <=> NEW.record_type)
            OR NOT (OLD.record_status <=> NEW.record_status)
            OR NOT (OLD.related_source_record_id <=> NEW.related_source_record_id)
            OR NOT (OLD.related_document_number_normalized <=> NEW.related_document_number_normalized)
            OR NOT (OLD.related_record_id <=> NEW.related_record_id)
            OR NOT (OLD.fingerprint <=> NEW.fingerprint)
            OR NOT (OLD.fingerprint_strength <=> NEW.fingerprint_strength)
            OR NOT (OLD.dedupe_key <=> NEW.dedupe_key)
            OR NOT (OLD.match_status <=> NEW.match_status)
            OR NOT (OLD.match_method <=> NEW.match_method)
            OR NOT (OLD.review_flags_json <=> NEW.review_flags_json)
            OR NOT (OLD.reviewed_by_user_id <=> NEW.reviewed_by_user_id)
            OR NOT (OLD.reviewed_at <=> NEW.reviewed_at)
            OR NOT (OLD.raw_row_json <=> NEW.raw_row_json)
            OR NOT (OLD.created_at <=> NEW.created_at)
        ) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
            SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Confirmed historical records are immutable';
    END IF;
END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_hist_records_immutable_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON historical_demand_records
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM historical_imports WHERE id = OLD.import_id AND status IN ('confirmed', 'reverted')) > 0 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000'
            SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Confirmed historical records are immutable';
    END IF;
END
